Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and can optimize the mods supplying your equipped glamour textures. Offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression with optional skin protection. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in installed and equipped Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Adds optional automatic optimization for the Penumbra mods supplying your currently equipped glamour textures. It waits for glamour changes to settle, processes each detected mod once per session, and respects your selected preset and skin protection setting.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Hands rest on your partner only when the animation already has them within about 3 cm of the skin, and let go past 6 cm, so hands meant for tables or the floor stay put. Shaft aiming and automatic line-up only correct small gaps. Tuned on 539 couple animations.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Beacon
Description: A directory of roleplay beacons anywhere in the world, not just in housing wards. Raise a beacon where your camp, court or crossroads actually is, describe it, show a screenshot, and let anyone travel to it across worlds and data centres. Light your beacon when you are there and open to play, and the atlas shows who is out there right now. Use /beacon to open the atlas.
Punchline: Find the fires. Light your own.
Changelog: Added a larger live portrait preview with zoom and position controls. Pictures up to 25 MB are cropped to 600x720 before upload and the new crop becomes the active portrait.
